signature_moves: Product thesis rendered as UI: one infinite canvas where live agent terminals, code diffs, notes, and web captures are co-equal movable nodes; chrome kept quiet-native so spatial content is the whole experience
Live PTY/agent sessions (Claude Code, opencode) embedded as first-class canvas nodes with real CLI banners, cursors and status footers — not screenshots

Colour-coded pipeline swimlanes: system identity hues + dashed connector rules give a freeform canvas a legible left-to-right process spine; category hues correctly separate from the single app accent
Textbook Jakob's Law: conventional interface (stock macOS Liquid Glass, real proxy pill, system accent) + innovative product (canvas model)
defects: None systematic. Soft flag only: node border hairlines (~1px light gray) sit near the #10 UI-contrast floor on white — unverifiable at composite zoom, not recorded as an anti-pattern

aesthetic.direction: Native macOS Liquid Glass workspace over a Freeform-style infinite canvas; brand layer pulls Terminal/hacker family (mono + code-glyph texture) toward an approachable geometric-display register

psychology: Jakob's Law — conventional macOS chrome so users feel at home; all novelty spent on the canvas (the product), not the interface
Von Restorff / signal-detection — the single accent-tinted pointer is the one coloured mark in a monochrome toolbar, so the active tool is pre-attentively obvious
Spatial memory / method of loci — infinite canvas encodes meaning in position; 'see the big picture' leverages peripheral + spatial cognition that a list view cannot
Miller/Cowan chunking — toolbar collapsed into ~3 glass clusters (identity / tools / actions) rather than a flat symbol row
Choice-overload calibration (correctly applied) — dense heterogeneous nodes are a browse/workspace surface, not a decision point, so density is a feature not overload
notes: Only ONE asset supplied: a marketing cover (2880x1800). The real app window is composited inside a MacBook Pro device frame at slightly-under-2x and the canvas is deliberately ZOOMED OUT to show scope, so node content is tiny and per-pixel token values are estimated with wide ranges. Structural/grammar evidence (lineage, glass discipline, toolbar grammar, node model) is high-confidence; numeric tokens are not. Cover carries strong SEPARATE brand evidence (lavender+code-glyph backdrop, geometric-display + monospace pairing, Liquid-Glass terminal app icon) recorded as brand-only, excluded from macOS canon. Not seen: settings, dark mode, empty state, onboarding, forms/inputs, sidebar contents. App icon (Workflow B) NOT digested — this was Workflow A (UI) only. Single app — no promotions; opens a candidate 'spatial-canvas' cluster with itself as sole member.
